summary: Licences now work only in their own tenant, and installing PIM Manager takes one guided command.

new.title: Guided installation (preview)
new.text: Install PIM Manager with one command from Azure Cloud Shell, signed in as yourself. It checks everything first, reports every step and can resume.

new.title: Grant or remove Invardia support access
new.text: One command gives the Invardia Support app read-only or setup access, and the same command takes it back.

fixes.title: Licences bound to their tenant
fixes.text: A licence now works only in the tenant it names. Every licence issued so far names its tenant, so you have nothing to do.

fixes.title: Access request portal deploys completely
fixes.text: Deploying the access request portal now also completes its registration and its mail permission.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Setup works from Linux and Azure Cloud Shell, and copying settings between environments can keep newer settings.
